lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five semi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of smaller spots transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with several prominent high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-colored highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two slender, elongated high-contrast features (likely remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
